lines.en: Small claws, silent steps.
I hug the ground like a shadow.

lines.zh: 黑角在头两边，眼睛发亮。
lines.en: Black horns, glowing gold eyes.
No flight, but I run fast.
I keep to the pack.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后划着弧。
lines.en: My tail traces an arc behind me.
I slip behind the chest.

lines.zh: 草地上的洞，我鼻子一拱。
lines.en: I nose into burrows in the grass.
My eyes shine brighter in the dark.
Not big, but bold.
I dart between two stones.
My steps weigh nothing.
I crouch on a branch, tail swaying.
Golden light shifts in my eyes.
Something glints — I want it.
I lick the dirt from between my claws.
Other dragons on the wind.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听树上的动静。
lines.en: Head tilted, I listen to the tree.
I dug this den myself.
Not hungry — just playful.
I'm counting the birds that pass.
Mud on my scales.
I yawn; my teeth are sharp.
I'm slyest when quiet.
I shift for a better angle.
Something sounds by the chest.
Room on your head?
Anything shiny in your pocket?

lines.zh: 我这么小，你差点没看见。
lines.en: So small you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 我眼睛黏在你手上的东西。
lines.en: My eyes stick to what you hold.
Those boots look chewable.
Have I ever brought you something?
Don't reach; let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 我眼睛亮，是因为看见你了。
lines.en: My eyes glow because I've spotted you.
Will you keep me?
I'll climb up your shoulder to look.
Our account isn't settled.
You smell of jerky.
I've circled you twice.
Don't worry; I don't bite nice people.

lines.zh: 你给我一把剑，我就帮你。
lines.en: Give me a sword and I'll help.
May I stay on your head?
You smiled — that's a yes.
Let me see if you're reliable.

lines.zh: 我的手很短，够不到你的脸。
lines.en: My arms are short; I can't reach your face.
My kin are in that flock.

lines.zh: 我发出像鸟又像蛇的叫声。
lines.en: I let out a cry halfway between bird and snake.
Ow! I roll over.
My legs still work; I can dart.
I duck into the grass.

lines.zh: 角上挨了一下，我晃了晃。
lines.en: A blow to my horn makes me stagger.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴缩到肚子底下。
lines.en: I curl my tail under my belly.
I retreat, eyes still on you.
That one I'll remember.
Small, but I still feel pain.
My cry turns fiercer.
Dragon eggs? I know these.
Does that smell good?
Dragon eggs or bugs — I eat both.

lines.zh: 龙蛋在手里转，我的头跟着转。
lines.en: The dragon egg turns in your hand and my head follows.
One egg and I'll follow you.
Not so tight; it'll break.
I'm at your feet now.
Not enough; I've a decent appetite.
It rolled away; I'm after it.
Crouch down and I'll dare take it.
I bump your leg headfirst.
I'm small; no harm done.
I tumble over.
Up again, shaking my head.
Your foot is far bigger than me.
I dodge once, then come back.
My horn caught you — does it hurt?

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞上我的角，我翻倒。
lines.en: Your knee meets my horn and I tumble.
That threw me half a meter.
I land on my feet.
A female in the flock looked my way.
I bring something shiny over.
We nudge snouts.
The den is lined with soft grass.
Her horns are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们三只一起出去找食。
lines.en: The three of us forage together.
Spring is the best season.
Not near this den, please.

lines.zh: 我把最好的那块留给她。
lines.en: I keep the best piece for her.
We guard the den together.
This one's shiny — mine.

lines.zh: 亮片藏进腮内，鼓了一边。
lines.en: The shiny bit goes into my cheek, one side bulging.
Too big for my claws.
It dropped; someone saw.
I filched this from a chest.

lines.zh: 这事只有我和箱子知道。
lines.en: Only the chest and I know about this.
I hide it in my den.
Not shiny; I drop it.
I run fast with it in my mouth.
Could this buy food?

lines.zh: 草尖一动，我金色的眼睛就过去了。
lines.en: A blade twitches and my golden eyes snap to it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一亮，就是锁定了。
lines.en: My eyes flare: locked on.
Quiet; don't startle it.

lines.zh: 这片草窝，我闭眼都能走。
lines.en: I could cross this burrow patch with my eyes shut.
I press my belly to the dirt.
Do you move first or do I?
It hasn't looked my way.
The target is three steps off.

lines.zh: 草里只剩我的眼睛在动。
lines.en: Only my eyes move in the grass.
Don't stand on my line of pounce.
My tail goes stiff.
This time I bite true.

lines.zh: 它身上有肉干和铁的味道。
lines.en: It smells of jerky and iron.
It's heading left.
My claws dig in.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一亮，就是信号。
lines.en: My eyes flare — that's the signal.
I follow without a sound.
It moves; I move.
I work around to its blind back.
Its heel hasn't touched the ground yet.
I wait in the grass for its head to drop.
I won't rush a single step.
Low in the grass, I barely breathe.
It looks back and I drop flat at once.
Then straight in.
My tail brushes the grass.
I creep along the grass roots.
I shift an inch that way.
It turned; I freeze.
Good — its back is turned again.
One more shift and I can reach.
Jaws shut — don't let go.
I burst out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，从它盲侧贴上去。
lines.en: I shift angle and creep up on its blind side.
I clamp onto its leg!

lines.zh: 我的牙短，可咬住就不放。
lines.en: My teeth are short, but once they catch, they hold.
Claws rake across.
A horn butt isn't light either.
I bite and spring back.
That's enough to slow it.
I circle it, biting from new angles.

lines.zh: 它转了几圈，我还在它脚边。
lines.en: It spins in circles; I'm still at its feet.

lines.zh: 这一口只撕开皮，下次更深。
lines.en: This bite only breaks skin; the next goes deeper.

lines.zh: 我发出一声尖利的嘶叫。
lines.en: I let out a piercing shriek.
I go for the ankle.
Its blood is in my mouth.
I bite once and slip back into the grass.
One more bite to finish.
Bite, then retreat — learn from it.

lines.zh: 第二口咬在它的小腿上。
lines.en: The second bite lands on its calf.

lines.zh: 我从草里钻出来，三只一起。
lines.en: Three of us emerge from the grass.
My eyes glow in the dark.
Any chests here?

lines.zh: 我从三只同伴中间探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out among three of my kin.
Grass caught on my horns.

lines.zh: 我们一群，五只到二十几只。
lines.en: We come in flocks of five to twenty-five.
Something fresh on the wind.
I shake my wings and tuck them.
Good den — livable.

lines.zh: 地上有脚印，不是我们的。
lines.en: Tracks here — not ours.
I crouch and wait for the flock.
Who's in the grass there?
My tail hasn't touched down yet.
No one about here.
Come, join our flock.
I smell meat.

lines.zh: 草地上多了几道小影子。
lines.en: Small shadows dot the grass.
I look up at my kin in the trees.
Fire sears my scales; I jump.
A fall from the tree leaves me dazed.

lines.zh: 水流进鼻孔，四只爪子乱抓。
lines.en: Water runs up my snout; all four claws scrabble.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻着跟头飞出去。
lines.en: The blast sends me tumbling.

lines.zh: 箭头擦过肋骨，带走一撮毛。
lines.en: The arrowhead grazes my ribs and takes a tuft of fur.

lines.zh: 光箍住我的爪，我挣不开。
lines.en: Light binds my claws; I can't pull free.
Hunger makes my hind legs shake.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我全身鳞都炸了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes; my scales bristle.
Nothing under me; I drop.
